skill: VERIFY CONTENT Use preview {id:<contentId>}. Open the returned URL before reporting a page visually complete. Draft preview links are temporary; expiresIn is seconds, not a permanent public URL. Never publish solely to inspect a draft. The actual frontend uses the active theme and installed block renderers. Private, password-protected or trashed content is not an eligible shared preview; respect refusals. A tokenized preview URL grants temporary access: share only with the intended user/client. Previewing one isolated block does not prove a whole page renders correctly. Frontend rendering also does not prove Gutenberg save() validation; reopen the editor after markup changes. For SEO verify emitted metadata as described in seo-contract; for forms rendering is not mail delivery. Preview a page assigned to the template to check its header, content slot and footer. The preview tool accepts content IDs; it does not provide standalone block/template previews.
